verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents broad REST and GraphQL API coverage for products, orders, customers, store settings, checkout, webhooks, B2B, and multi-store management, suggesting most UI operations have API equivalents, and even provides sandbox/trial environments and an API Request Runner for testing. However, there is no explicit vendor statement guaranteeing 100% UI-to-API parity, and a community report notes historical issues with reliably connecting to the API without throttling. Missing for 10: an explicit parity guarantee/documentation mapping every control-panel action to an API endpoint, and independent hands-on confirmation that all admin UI actions (e.g., full theme/store configuration) are API-accessible without gaps.
